raised: The '123 מקור / חושב / הזנתה' legend line is confusing; the reader doesn't know what the symbols mean
The page never says what retirement age is, so the reader can't tell if the 3-year rule applies to them at 61
The 'כדאי להכיר גם' / 'במה אפשר להשקיע בתוכו' buttons don't help the reader choose a track
The explanation of the two compared funds, with long names and numbers, is too full of jargon
Employment type and salary can't be changed; the reader doesn't know if their salary would change the result
The comparison gap of only 415.84 ₪ looks small, because the employer's money is left out
The key paragraphs about 300/200 ₪ and the employer's 7.5% are in small print
The reader didn't understand the remark about a 'pair finance' company
The phrase 'שנת הדרכים' is confusing
The 'שחקו עם המספרים שלכם' section couldn't be opened
The codes TXH-09 / KH-15 / PF-18 mean nothing to the reader
The reader doesn't understand why particular company names appear (Harel, Altshuler Shaham, Meitav, the fees table)
The orange box's 47% withholding that 'isn't the final tax' is confusing; no actual figure is given
The chief economist's recommendation to cut the benefit makes the reader worry whether it will last
The reader doesn't know whether the 'חוקים וכללים · X' tags can be clicked or what they show
The reader didn't understand the small empty square under the yellow bar
The glossary's 'איפה מופיע' column is ignored and would be dropped, along with the 'הצגת מונחים' buttons
The reader can't put a shekel figure on 'real profit' and the 25% tax on it
No guidance on which investment track suits someone aged 61
The page doesn't show the total after 6 years with the employer's money included
The page doesn't say what happens to the fund if the reader leaves their job or retires, or whether money can stay in tax-free
The page doesn't say what a normal management fee is or whether 0.54% is good or can be negotiated
The reader would drop the 123 legend line
The reader would drop the codes and the 'חוקים וכללים' tags
The reader would drop all the self-employed content as irrelevant to a salaried worker
The employer's 7.5% sentence should be moved to the top of the page

problems.why: The reader quoted the 7.5% sentence and assumed the employer's money goes into the fund, but never said it was unclear whether it goes to the study fund or a pension fund.
